name: Forearm Plank
formCue: Ribs down, squeeze glutes, straight line head to heels

name: Bicycle Crunch
formCue: Slow elbow to opposite knee, low back stays down

name: Dead Bug
formCue: Low back pressed into the floor, move opposite arm and leg

name: Side Plank
formCue: Hips high, stack shoulders over elbow

name: Flutter Kicks
formCue: Small fast kicks, keep lower back down

name: Mountain Climbers
formCue: Hips level, drive knees to chest

name: Hollow Hold
formCue: Lower back glued down, arms and legs long

name: Russian Twist
formCue: Chest tall, rotate from the ribs, not the arms

name: Bird Dog
formCue: Reach long, keep hips square to the floor

name: Reverse Crunch
formCue: Curl the pelvis up, no swinging

name: Plank Shoulder Taps
formCue: Hips still, tap the opposite shoulder without rocking

name: Superman Hold
formCue: Lift arms and legs together, keep your neck long

name: V-Up
formCue: Reach hands to toes, lower with control

name: Cat-Cow
formCue: Round then arch the spine slowly, breathe with the movement

name: Glute Bridge
formCue: Squeeze glutes at the top, ribs down

name: Standing Torso Twist
formCue: Hips forward, rotate through the ribcage with loose arms

name: Crunch
formCue: Chin off chest, lift shoulder blades, ribs toward hips

name: Heel Taps
formCue: Reach fingertips to heels side to side, shoulders stay lifted

name: Leg Lowers
formCue: Lower legs slowly, stop before your low back lifts

name: Hollow Rock
formCue: Stay hollow like a banana, rock from shoulders to hips

name: High Plank Hold
formCue: Hands under shoulders, ribs down, straight line head to heels

name: Plank Hip Dips
formCue: Forearms planted, rotate hips side to side, shoulders still

name: Spider Plank
formCue: Knee to same-side elbow, hips low and level

name: Cross-Body Mountain Climbers
formCue: Drive knee toward the opposite elbow, hips low

name: Bear Plank
formCue: Knees hover an inch off the floor, back flat

name: Side Plank Hip Dips
formCue: Lower hip toward the floor, lift back up, shoulders stacked

name: Standing Knee-to-Elbow
formCue: Drive knee across to the opposite elbow, stand tall

name: Wood Chop
formCue: Sweep hands high to low across the body, pivot your feet

name: Inchworm
formCue: Walk hands out to plank, walk feet back in, soft knees

name: Reach Through
formCue: From all-fours, reach one arm under, rotate through the upper back

name: Sit up
formCue: Feet planted, curl up with control, keep your neck relaxed

name: Plank Walk
formCue: Hips level as you walk your hands out and back

name: Windsheild wipers
formCue: Legs up, arms wide, lower both legs side to side

name: Cross-Body Crunch
formCue: Elbow to opposite knee, legs up or down; one side at a time

name: Single leg bicycle
formCue: One leg out, one leg in, elbow to opposite knee
